summary.text: Gene Dvornick is the Republican candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Alonna Berry.
A government administrator, he lists 20 years as Georgetown Town Manager and describes himself as a moderate Republican.

paragraphs.text: Gene Dvornick earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from Shepherd University in 1986, a master's degree in accounting from Virginia Tech in 1987, and a master's degree in public administration from the University of Delaware in 2020.
He has also earned certifications from the Delaware State Fire School and the International City/County Management Association.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Dvornick gave his Delaware hometown as Milton and listed a 20-year tenure as Georgetown Town Manager and 40 years as a volunteer firefighter with the Milton Fire Department, where he has served as chief, captain, assistant chief and deputy chief.

He also listed service as a former Milton Town Council member, a gubernatorial appointment to the State of Delaware Clean Water Advisory Council, and a seat on the board of First State Community Action.
Dvornick said in the survey that he is running as a moderate Republican and that one-party rule and limited state revenue streams are the most pressing concerns facing Delaware families.

He said infrastructure in the 20th District has not kept pace with population and housing growth, and that he would seek a better balance between the realty transfer tax revenue the district generates and the funding returned to it.
